name: SmartMatch
summary: AI candidate matching built for aviation hiring. It reads licences, aircraft types, recency and approvals instead of generic CV keywords, across an audience of more than 150,000 registered aviation professionals.
paragraphs: AI candidate matching built for aviation hiring. It reads licences, aircraft types, recency and approvals instead of generic CV keywords, across an audience of more than 150,000 registered aviation professionals.
whyItMatters: Search and shortlist for free, and pay only when you decide to contact someone. Run your hardest open req (say, a B1 or A&P with a specific type) through it before you pay an agency fee.
